audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Unbreakable as the read but has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never states Concussive Blows (P) can cancel Pyke's Q channel if it stuns mid-cast.
audit.why: Unbreakable (E) is 16-8s and negates the first hit from a direction, including Bone Skewer's projectile. Concussive Blows is hard CC at 4 stacks, which cancels an in-progress Q channel.

edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Unbreakable (E) is 16/14/12/10/8s and blocks your Q projectile outright — wait it out before you poke. - His passive stuns at 4 Concussive Blows stacks and cancels your Q channel if it lands mid-cast. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades.
